review_scope: Preparation and offline static review only; root must review before deploy or admission.
objective: Compare the existing native MPI-init probe to a fail-closed post-init per-host core-topology-selected main-thread pin audit.
checks: Baseline probe bytes exactly match the collected payload source from completed job 26004608.
Candidate requires world 512, four processor-name groups of 128, shared communicator size 128, and local/world host membership agreement.
Only each local communicator rank zero reads sysfs for CPUs in its own post-init allowed mask; missing, negative, offline, or ambiguous package/core/NUMA mappings fail the local gate.

Exactly 128 distinct physical package/core identities are required; the lowest allowed logical CPU per core is selected in deterministic package/core order and the complete per-host sysfs map is retained.
Every rank verifies its selected CPU is in its own observed post-init allowed mask and online before the all-rank gate permits sched_setaffinity(0).
The call is explicitly a main-thread binding; immediate, post-Allreduce, post-two-second monotonic wait, and post-final-Allreduce masks are recorded.

The worker records and propagates each arm exit status, caps each arm at 60 seconds, enforces 255 seconds internally, and preserves 25 seconds before the 275-second outer timeout within a 300-second PBS request.
Synthetic positive topology/512-rank replay and 15 negative topology, slot, identity, target-mask and phase cases pass.
Both native C files pass strict warning syntax checks with a narrow local MPI declaration shim; this is not an MPI build or runtime claim.
PBS request maximum is 42.666667 SU at 1 SU per CPU-hour; a fresh queue/project/budget gate remains in the deployment/admission code.
